clerk_role: county clerk: prepares and verifies county canvass; election administration
county_canvassing_role: NMSA 1-13-1: commissioners ex officio, or designated board of registration; exact 2026 county designation not independently established
state_canvassing_role: state canvassing board certifies statewide/multicounty results; SOS prepares and publishes
publisher_role: official local pages and SOS/linked public publishers as individually evidenced; historical, primary and setup stages kept distinct
local_investigation: Santa Fe clerk elections page works and links current general page, historical results and SOS county results (cty=01). Followed current general page works; actual no-eid county result request redirects. Explicit old eid values are history only.
